docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Three brothers, a violent father and a murder: Dostoevsky's last novel, with the Grand Inquisitor, takes on faith, doubt, guilt and freedom.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Fyodor Dostoevsky (1821–1881), Bratya Karamazovy (Russian), 1879–1880, translated by Constance Garnett (1861–1946), 1912. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
